title: kramdown undefined link IDs (Type[] notation)
description: kramdown 'No link definition for link ID' warnings: empty ID in chat-00 (~44), federation (11), vtc-00 (16), push (6), mimi (3), chat-wss (3), graph-search (3), graph-00 (2), graph-edit (2), scene-wss (2), vtc-wss (2), tasks, did, graph-projection, scene-00 (1 each); ID '3'/'4' in scene-00 (18) and scene-wss (1); '*' in graph-00 (3); named 'reaction' (chat-00), 'chatpushconfig' (push), 'graphrights' (graph-00). kramdown line numbers are body-relative (after YAML header), not file lines. Likely cause: JMAP type notation like Type[] / Number[3] / GraphRights written outside backticks, parsed as reference links. Confirm rendering, then backtick or escape.
